description:
Search for travel listings with filters, sorting, and pagination.

Use when find_trips lacks a filter the user needs.

Required parameters:
- niche: ONE travel type — "ski", "golf", "surf", "diving", "hiking", "charter", "cycling", "football", "carrental", "f1", "running", "americanfootball", "yoga", "triathlon", "cruise", "coach", "holidayhome", "roundtrip", "citybreak", "dance", "wellness", "safari", "culture", "sportsevent", "camping", "hunting", "culinary", "fishing", "language", "racket", "motorcycle", "riding", "birding", "sailing", "concert", "umrah". Single niche per request.
- market: market code (one of "dk")

Common filters (valid for every niche):
- adults (ALWAYS include — prices depend on group size)
- children (ALWAYS include — prices depend on group size)
- departureFrom (YYYY-MM-DD)
- departureTo (YYYY-MM-DD)
- onlyDiscounted (boolean — only trips with a discount)
- onlyMultiDestination (boolean — only trips that sleep in more than one place (round trips, stage tours))
- countries (array of country slugs — use EXACT slugs, e.g. ["austria"])
- destinations (array of destination slugs in country_destination format, e.g. ["austria_zell-am-see"] — use EXACT slugs. Also returns round trips and stage tours that stop there; their `accommodation.route` lists every stop)
- providers (array of provider slugs)
- centrumDistance ({ min, max } meters to town centre)
- minPrice (total price, not per person)
- maxPrice (total price, not per person)
- minPricePerPerson (per-person price)
- maxPricePerPerson (per-person price)
- durations (array of trip lengths in days, e.g. [7, 14])
- arrivalWeeks (array of ISO weeks, e.g. ["2026-W15"] — use for "next week")
- arrivalMonths (array of months, e.g. ["2026-04"] — use for "in April")
- arrivalDates (array of exact arrival dates, YYYY-MM-DD)
- departureDateFlexDays (0-7, day flex around arrivalDates)
- minStars (minimum hotel star rating, 1-5)
- minGuestRating (guest review score 0-10 (TripAdvisor scores are ×2 normalized))
- maxGuestRating (guest review score 0-10)
- includeUnratedGuestRating (boolean — keep unrated hotels in rated searches)
- transports (array: bus, train, car, flight_bll, flight_cph, flight_aal, flight_arn, flight_got, flight_ham, flight_aar, flight_krp, flight_rnn, flight_ams, flight_ein, flight_rtm, flight_grq, flight_mst, flight_bru, flight_dus, flight_nrn, flight_cgn, flight_osl, flight_bgo, flight_svg, flight_trd, flight_mmx, flight_jkg, flight_krs, flight_crl, flight_fmo, flight_dtm, flight_fra, flight_muc, flight_ber, flight_str, flight_ksf, flight_nue, flight_scn, flight_pad, flight_drs, flight_erf, flight_lej, flight_rlg, flight_fdh, flight_fkb, flight_fmm, flight_bre, flight_haj, flight_vie, flight_szg, flight_grz, flight_inn, flight_lnz, flight_klu, flight_zrh, flight_bsl, flight_gva, flight_brn, flight_lux, flight_lhr, flight_lgw, flight_man, flight_stn, flight_ltn, flight_bhx, flight_edi, flight_gla, flight_brs, flight_ncl, flight_anr, flight_lgg, flight_ost, flight_mad, flight_bcn, flight_pmi, flight_agp, flight_alc, flight_vlc, flight_svq, flight_bio, flight_cdg, flight_ory, flight_lys, flight_mrs, flight_nce, flight_tls, flight_bod, flight_nte, flight_bva, flight_lil, flight_fco, flight_mxp, flight_bgy, flight_lin, flight_vce, flight_blq, flight_nap, flight_cta, flight_trn — a trip sold without the flight is never under a flight_<airport>: it is car, own travel (drive, or a flight the traveller books))
- accommodationTypes (array: hotel, apartment, cabin, chalet, villa, hostel, resort, pension, house, other)
- mealPlanTypes (array: all_inclusive, breakfast, full_board, half_board, none)
- accommodationFeatures (array, e.g. pool, wifi, sauna, spa, parking, bar)

Niche-specific filters (only valid when niche matches):
- Ski: skiPassIncluded (boolean), skiPassDaysCount ({ min, max } bundled lift-pass days), skiLiftDistance ({ min, max } meters), skiBusDistance ({ min, max } meters), skiSlopeDistance ({ min, max } meters), guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …))
- Golf (accommodation-centric like ski; greenFeeIncluded says whether ANY golf is in the price, golfRoundsRanges/golfBagIncluded refine it further; guideIncluded is a golf host, not a generic tour guide): greenFeeIncluded (boolean — the package price includes green fees (any rounds or unlimited golf); false = golf is bought separately), courseDistance ({ min, max } meters, hotel to nearest course), golfRoundsRanges (array: none, 1-3, 4-5, 6+, unlimited — rounds included per golfer ('none' = green fee not included)), golfTripTypes (array: stay, school, group, longstay, tour — 'stay' is the default golf-hotel package), golfBagIncluded (boolean — golf bag carried on the flight at no extra charge), guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …))
- Surf (diving's shape (one card = one seller's board-sport trip: a surf, kite, windsurf or wing camp or week with lessons, coaching or guiding in the price; offers are dated weeks or season windows x party); adults = the number of surfers, a non-surfing companion is not in the party, children only where the seller prices them; price is the party total for the trip; a season window (dateFlexible) matches any date search it overlaps, from its first bookable day to seasonEnd; boardSports/surfLevels/instructions/surfAccommodations are OR-matched; every boolean is null when the seller does not say, never false): transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …)), dateFlexible (boolean — hunting, diving, fishing, language, surf, racket and riding: true = season windows only (one offer the traveller books any days inside, e.g. "1/5-31/7", "hver lørdag hele året", a language course starting every Monday of a price season, a surf or padel camp open every week of its season, a riding farm stay bookable any day of its season), false = fixed-date departures only; absent = both), boardSports (array: surf, kitesurf, windsurf, wingfoil, sup — the board sports taught or guided in the price (kitesurf = kite, wingfoil = wing, sup = stand up paddle); matches a trip with ANY of them), surfLevels (array: beginner, intermediate, advanced, all — the level the seller prints (all = every level welcome, so add it to a beginner ask); matches ANY of them), instructions (array: lessons, guiding, both — lessons = surfskole / kursus, guiding = a surf guide takes you to the spots, both = lessons and guiding; matches ANY of them), surfAccommodations (array: camp, hotel, apartment, house, tent, boat — where the surfers sleep; matches ANY of them), lessonDays (object { min?, max? } — days with lessons / sessions in the price (not the nights of the stay); a trip that does not say never matches a bound), equipmentIncluded (boolean — board / kite / wetsuit are in the price (rental offered as an extra = false); null (not stated) never matches), yogaIncluded (boolean — yoga sessions are in the price (surf & yoga weeks); null (not stated) never matches)
- Diving (hunting's shape (one card = one seller's dive trip: a liveaboard, a dive-resort or dive-camp package, a group trip; offers are dated departures or season windows x party); adults = the number of divers, a non-diving companion is not in the party; price is the party total and never includes marine-park, fuel or chamber fees paid on site; a season window (dateFlexible) matches any date search it overlaps, from its first bookable day to seasonEnd; diveTripTypes/diveAreas/certifications are OR-matched; every boolean is null when the seller does not say, never false): diveTripTypes (array: liveaboard, resort, dive_camp, course_trip — liveaboard = safaribåd / dykkersafari, resort = dive-resort package, dive_camp = dykkerlejr, course_trip = a certification course on the trip; matches ANY of them), diveAreas (array — the sellers' own dive-area slugs (red-sea-north, red-sea-south, maldives, raja-ampat, …); use the destination filters for a country or resort), certifications (array: open_water, advanced, rescue, tech — the lowest certificate the trip requires; a diver with open water wants ['open_water']), divesIncluded (object { min?, max? } — total dives in the price; a trip that does not say never matches a bound), nitroxIncluded (boolean — nitrox is in the price), gearIncluded (boolean — full gear rental is in the price (tank and weights alone are not gear)), danishDiveLeader (boolean — a Danish dive leader or instructor travels with the group), unlimitedHouseReef (boolean — unlimited shore / house-reef diving is in the price), parkFeesIncluded (boolean — park / conservation fees (and permits) are in the price (diving: marine-park, fuel and port fees)), dateFlexible (boolean — hunting, diving, fishing, language, surf, racket and riding: true = season windows only (one offer the traveller books any days inside, e.g. "1/5-31/7", "hver lørdag hele året", a language course starting every Monday of a price season, a surf or padel camp open every week of its season, a riding farm stay bookable any day of its season), false = fixed-date departures only; absent = both)
- Hiking: difficultyLevels (array), dailyDistance, trailheadDistance ({ min, max } meters), hikingTripFormats, routeDistance ({ min, max } km), elevationGain ({ min, max } meters), luggageTransportIncluded (boolean), guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), gpxAvailable (boolean)
- Charter: beachDistance ({ min, max } meters), guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …))
- Cycling: cyclingDifficultyLevels (array: easy, moderate, challenging, hard, expert), cyclingTypes (array: road, gravel, mountainbike, e_mountainbike, e_bike, bike_cruise, event), tripFormats (array: self_guided, guided_group, private_custom, club_event, race_event), routeDistance ({ min, max } km), elevationGain ({ min, max } meters), eBikeAvailable (boolean), luggageTransportIncluded (boolean), guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), bikeRentalAvailable (boolean), gpxAvailable (boolean)
- Football (match-centric; the match ticket is always included, transport fly/kør-selv via the shared transports filter): leagues (array of league slugs, e.g. ["premier-league", "la-liga"] or ["nfl"] — use EXACT slugs from the league facet), teams (array of team slugs, e.g. ["wolverhampton-wanderers"] or ["kansas-city-chiefs"] — use EXACT slugs from the team facet; matches the home OR away side), matchDateFrom (YYYY-MM-DD, kickoff date), matchDateTo (YYYY-MM-DD, kickoff date), hotelIncluded (boolean)
- Carrental (groups by car group at a pickup station; adults/children do not price a car — they only set minSeats; prices are per rental, not per person): carSuppliers (array of rental-brand slugs, e.g. ["avis"] — use EXACT slugs from the carSupplier facet), carClasses (array: mini, economy, compact, intermediate, standard, fullsize, premium, luxury, special), carBodyTypes (array: car, suv, estate, van, convertible, other), transmissions (array: manual, automatic), fuelTypes (array: petrol, diesel, hybrid, electric), minSeats (integer 1-20, minimum seats — set it from the party size), zeroExcess (boolean — only rate tiers without an excess (ingen selvrisiko)), pickupStations (array of pickup-station slugs, e.g. ["london-heathrow-t5"] — use EXACT slugs from the pickupStation facet), pickupStationTypes (array: airport, city, rail, port, other)
- F1 (event-centric (one card = one Grand Prix weekend); the race ticket is always included, hotel via hotelIncluded, transport fly/kør-selv via the shared transports filter; guideIncluded = a tour leader travels with the group): guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), hotelIncluded (boolean), races (array of race slugs, e.g. ["monaco"] (f1), ["berlin-marathon"] (running) or ["ironman-kalmar"] (triathlon) — use EXACT slugs from the race facet), seasons (array of season years, e.g. [2026]), raceDateFrom (YYYY-MM-DD, race day (not the travel dates); a triathlon camp: its departure date), raceDateTo (YYYY-MM-DD, race day (not the travel dates); a triathlon camp: its departure date), ticketTypes (array: grandstand, general_admission, hospitality), raceDays (array: 3_day, 2_day, 1_day (Fri–Sun / Sat–Sun / race day only)), transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …))
- Running (event-centric: one card = one race edition (tripTypes race) or one running camp / guided trail tour (tripTypes camp, its departures are the offers); the race entry is NOT always included (entryIncluded), arrival/departure are the travel window around the race day, raceDate* = race day for races, departure date for camps, hotel via hotelIncluded): guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), hotelIncluded (boolean), races (array of race slugs, e.g. ["monaco"] (f1), ["berlin-marathon"] (running) or ["ironman-kalmar"] (triathlon) — use EXACT slugs from the race facet), seasons (array of season years, e.g. [2026]), raceDateFrom (YYYY-MM-DD, race day (not the travel dates); a triathlon camp: its departure date), raceDateTo (YYYY-MM-DD, race day (not the travel dates); a triathlon camp: its departure date), transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …)), distances (array: 5k, 10k, half_marathon, marathon, ultra, other — matches a package offering ANY of them), terrains (array: road, trail), raceSeries (array: majors, superhalfs — World Marathon Majors / SuperHalfs), entryIncluded (boolean — the race entry (bib / startnummer) is bundled; false = not bundled (it may be a paid add-on or not offered at all — never promise the traveller can buy one)), tripTypes (array: race, camp — triathlon and running: race = a package to a named race, camp = a dated training camp (running: also a running week or guided trail tour))
- Americanfootball (event-centric (one card = one NFL game, mostly the International Series in London/Paris/Madrid/Munich plus the Super Bowl); the game ticket is always included, hotel via hotelIncluded; a Super Bowl sold before the bracket has no teams — use gameTypes ["super_bowl"], not teams): guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), leagues (array of league slugs, e.g. ["premier-league", "la-liga"] or ["nfl"] — use EXACT slugs from the league facet), teams (array of team slugs, e.g. ["wolverhampton-wanderers"] or ["kansas-city-chiefs"] — use EXACT slugs from the team facet; matches the home OR away side), matchDateFrom (YYYY-MM-DD, kickoff date), matchDateTo (YYYY-MM-DD, kickoff date), hotelIncluded (boolean), seasons (array of season years, e.g. [2026]), transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …)), gameTypes (array: preseason, regular_season, playoffs, super_bowl (International Series games abroad are regular_season))
- Yoga (destination-centric (one card = one retreat venue); yogaStyles is OR-matched, and unknown booleans are unset, never false): transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …)), yogaRetreatFocuses (array: yoga, yoga_hiking, yoga_surf, yoga_wellness, yoga_active, yoga_culture, teacher_training — what the retreat pairs yoga with; teacher_training = a 200h/500h course), yogaLevels (array: beginner, all_levels, intermediate, advanced), yogaStyles (array: hatha, vinyasa, yin, ashtanga, kundalini, iyengar, restorative, yoga_nidra, power, aerial, somatic, other — matches a retreat teaching ANY of them), meditationIncluded (boolean — meditation or mindfulness is part of the programme), vegetarianMeals (boolean — the kitchen is vegetarian (not just a vegetarian option on request)), danishInstructor (boolean — the yoga teacher teaches in Danish), groupSizeMax (object { min?, max? } — yoga, roundtrip, safari, culture, culinary, birding and sailing: the printed maximum number of participants ({ max: 12 } = small groups); a trip that does not print one never matches a bound)
- Triathlon (event-centric: one card = one race edition (tripTypes race) or one training camp (tripTypes camp, its departures are the offers); the race entry is usually NOT included (entryIncluded); raceDate* = race day for races, departure date for camps): guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), hotelIncluded (boolean), races (array of race slugs, e.g. ["monaco"] (f1), ["berlin-marathon"] (running) or ["ironman-kalmar"] (triathlon) — use EXACT slugs from the race facet), seasons (array of season years, e.g. [2026]), raceDateFrom (YYYY-MM-DD, race day (not the travel dates); a triathlon camp: its departure date), raceDateTo (YYYY-MM-DD, race day (not the travel dates); a triathlon camp: its departure date), transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …)), entryIncluded (boolean — the race entry (bib / startnummer) is bundled; false = not bundled (it may be a paid add-on or not offered at all — never promise the traveller can buy one)), tripTypes (array: race, camp — triathlon and running: race = a package to a named race, camp = a dated training camp (running: also a running week or guided trail tour)), triathlonDistances (array: full, half, olympic, sprint, other — full = IRONMAN, half = 70.3, olympic = 5150; matches ANY of them), raceBrands (array: ironman, challenge, other), bikeTransportIncluded (boolean — the traveller’s own bike is carried to the start in the price (triathlon: the athlete’s bike flies with the package; motorcycle: the seller ships the rider’s own motorcycle); false = an add-on or not offered)
- Cruise (one card = one sailing (ship + embarkation port + length); cruiseLines is the ship operator, never the reselling agency; drinksIncluded/excursionsIncluded/guideIncluded are all null when the line does not say): guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), cruiseTypes (array: ocean, river, coastal, expedition), cruiseLines (array: msc, costa, royal_caribbean, celebrity, norwegian, princess, holland_america, carnival, cunard, p_and_o, disney, virgin_voyages, oceania, regent, azamara, silversea, seabourn, explora, windstar, ponant, viking, hurtigruten, havila, ambassador, fred_olsen, aida, tui_cruises, amawaterways, nicko, a_rosa, avalon, uniworld, scenic, other — the ship operator, not the reselling agency), cabinTypes (array: inside, oceanview, balcony, suite — cheapest bookable category the offer prices), cruiseRegions (array: mediterranean, norwegian_fjords, northern_europe, baltic, british_isles, atlantic_islands, arctic, antarctica, caribbean, north_america, alaska, south_america, asia, middle_east, africa, oceania, transatlantic, world, rhine, danube, douro, seine, rhone, elbe, nile, mekong, other_river), embarkationCountries (array of country slugs the ship departs from), drinksIncluded (boolean — an onboard drinks package is bundled), excursionsIncluded (boolean — excursions are bundled (shore excursions on a cruise, sightseeing on a coach tour, round trip, culture trip or city break))
- Coach (destination-centric like cycling (one card = one seller's tour, departures are the offers); pickupRegions matches a tour boarding in ANY chosen Danish region; guideIncluded/excursionsIncluded are shared with cruise and null when the operator does not say): guideIncluded (boolean — a guide is in the price (riding: a riding guide or instructor); null (not stated) never matches), excursionsIncluded (boolean — excursions are bundled (shore excursions on a cruise, sightseeing on a coach tour, round trip, culture trip or city break)), coachTripTypes (array: round_trip, city_break, christmas_market, holiday_stay, garden, event, wellness, other), pickupRegions (array: north_jutland, central_jutland, south_jutland, funen, zealand, copenhagen, bornholm — the Danish region the coach boards in, matches ANY chosen region)
- Holidayhome (one card = one specific rentable house; price is per HOUSE for the stay, never per person — adults/children only set a capacity floor (maxPersons >= adults + children), same mechanism as carrental minSeats; beachDistance is shared with charter and camping; maxPersons is that ROW's price-band top (a house priced by party size emits one row per band, e.g. a "2-person offer"), never the house's real capacity — when telling the visitor what a house sleeps, use houseCapacity, and never phrase a result as "max N persons"): beachDistance ({ min, max } meters), minBedrooms (minimum bedrooms), houseSizeRanges (array: 0-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-250, 250+ — living area in m² (the house, or the camping unit), matches ANY of them), petsAllowed (boolean — pets are allowed in the house or camping unit), consumptionIncluded (boolean — electricity, water and heating are included in the price), freeCancellation (boolean — only prices that can be cancelled free of charge (refundable rate); without it a house or unit shows its cheapest rate, often non-refundable)
- Roundtrip (coach's shape (one card = one seller's multi-stop tour, departures are the offers); the overnight places are route stops, so a town search finds every tour sleeping there; price is the party total (per person in a shared double for even parties, single supplement included for one traveller or an odd party); danishGuide/guaranteedDeparture/excursionsIncluded are null when the seller does not say): excursionsIncluded (boolean — excursions are bundled (shore excursions on a cruise, sightseeing on a coach tour, round trip, culture trip or city break)), tourFormats (array: guided_group, small_group, self_drive, private — self_drive is a fly & drive round trip in a rental car with a fixed day plan, not a car-rental search), danishGuide (boolean — a Danish-speaking tour guide is stated (birding: a Danish ornithologist or Danish tour leader travels, read off the bird guide); null when the seller does not say), guaranteedDeparture (boolean — the departure is guaranteed to run; null when the seller does not say, never read as "not guaranteed"), groupSizeMax (object { min?, max? } — yoga, roundtrip, safari, culture, culinary, birding and sailing: the printed maximum number of participants ({ max: 12 } = small groups); a trip that does not print one never matches a bound)
- Citybreak (charter-shaped: one card = one city hotel, each offer a date x stay length x departure airport x party; the price is the party total for the stay as the seller quotes it; escorted = a fixed-date trip with a tour leader (a plain city-break search is a free flight+hotel stay, so set escorted only when the visitor wants a leader); centrumDistance is the key city-break quality signal; transferIncluded/excursionsIncluded are null when the seller does not say): transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …)), excursionsIncluded (boolean — excursions are bundled (shore excursions on a cruise, sightseeing on a coach tour, round trip, culture trip or city break)), escorted (boolean — a fixed-date trip with a tour leader and a programme; absent = everything, including free flight+hotel stays)
- Dance (destination-centric like yoga (one card = one dance week at one venue); danceStyles is OR-matched, and unknown booleans are unset, never false): transferIncluded (boolean — the transfer from the airport/station (or circuit) to the accommodation is bundled; null (not stated) never matches. Shared by the event, ski, charter and tour niches (yoga, language, surf, racket, riding …)), danceStyles (array: ballroom, latin, tango, swing, linedance, flamenco, dance_fitness, other — matches a dance week teaching ANY of them), danceLevels (array: beginner, all_levels, intermediate, advanced), soloWelcome (boolean — true = the page says you can come without a dance partner; false = a partner is needed (pardans); most weeks leave it unset, so for a solo traveller prefer danceStyles linedance or dance_fitness over this filter)
- Wellness (hotel-centric like charter (one card = one spa hotel or retreat venue, each offer a date x nights x party, priced for the whole party); programTypes and spaAccess are OR-matched, and unknown booleans are unset, never false): programTypes (array: spa_stay, cure, ayurveda, fasting_detox, mindfulness_retreat, active_retreat, health_retreat — spa_stay = spaophold / spa & dinner, cure = kurophold, fasting_detox = faste / detox, mindfulness_retreat = meditation / stilhed without a yoga core (yoga retreats are the yoga niche); matches ANY of them), spaAccess (array: unlimited, timed, entrance_only, none — unlimited = "fri adgang", timed = a stated time window or session count, entrance_only = one entry), treatmentsIncluded (boolean — at least one treatment (massage, facial, bath) is in the price; unset when the seller does not say), dinnerIncluded (boolean — at least one dinner (e.g. a 3-course menu) is in the price), guidedProgramme (boolean — a scheduled programme or classes (retreat schedule, fitness/yoga classes, guided sauna) are in the price), doctorConsultation (boolean — a doctor or ayurvedic doctor consultation is in the price (cures, health retreats))
- Safari (round trip's shape (one card = one seller's safari, departures are the offers); the parks and camps are route stops, so a search for a park finds every safari sleeping there; price is the party total for the departure; safariTypes/wildlifeFocus are OR-matched; a land-only safari (no flight in the price) is transports car; every boolean is null when the seller does not say, never false): tourFormats (array: guided_group, small_group, self_drive, private — self_drive is a fly & drive round trip in a rental car with a fixed day plan, not a car-rental search), danishGuide (boolean — a Danish-speaking tour guide is stated (birding: a Danish ornithologist or Danish tour leader travels, read off the bird guide); null when the seller does not say), safariBases (array: circuit, single_lodge — circuit = moves between parks / camps, single_lodge = drives out from one base), accommodationStyles (array: lodge, tented_camp, camping, hotel, mixed — tented_camp = teltlejr; matches ANY of them), safariTypes (array: game_drive, night_drive, walking, boat, mokoro, balloon, horseback, gorilla_trek, chimp_trek — activities in the price (a paid add-on does not count); matches a safari offering ANY of them), wildlifeFocus (array: big_five, great_migration, gorillas, chimpanzees, tigers, polar_bears, lemurs — the animals the page names as the trip's focus; matches ANY of them), privateVehicle (boolean — the party has its own safari vehicle; unset when the seller does not say), windowSeatGuaranteed (boolean — a window seat in the safari vehicle is guaranteed ("vinduesplads garanteret")), beachStayIncluded (boolean — a beach or island extension (Zanzibar, Mauritius, Watamu) is in the price), parkFeesIncluded (boolean — park / conservation fees (and permits) are in the price (diving: marine-park, fuel and port fees)), groupSizeMax (object { min?, max? } — yoga, roundtrip, safari, culture, culinary, birding and sailing: the printed maximum number of participants ({ max: 12 } = small groups); a trip that does not print one never matches a bound)

Sorting & pagination:
- sort: one of "price", "pricePerPerson", "departureDate", "stars", "kompareScore" (Kompare’s ranking weighs the price against similar trips, hotel stars, guest ratings, how well the trip fits the party and the commission the travel agency pays Kompare. Agencies with a commission agreement always rank above those without.), "discountPercentage", "distanceToCentrum", "distanceToLift" (ski ONLY — silently sorts by price on every other niche, so never offer it there), "providerMix"
- order: "asc" or "desc"
- limit: results per page (1-100)
- offset: pagination offset

IMPORTANT: countries and destinations use EXACT slug matching — always use the exact slugs returned by search_init (topDestinations) or get_facets (countrySlug/destinationSlug facets). Do NOT guess slugs.

Response — the matching accommodations with their trips:
{ total, accommodationCount, offset, results: [{ name, country, destination, stars, guestRating, tripsAvailable, trips: [{ start, end, durationDays, adults, children, price, pricePerPerson, currency, priceBeforeDiscount, transport, meals, unit, seller, bookingUrl }] }] }
- price is the whole party's price; pricePerPerson divides it. Quote them as given, in currency — never convert or round them into a different claim.
- trips holds the first few dates in sort order; tripsAvailable says how many more exist. Page with offset (it counts accommodations).
- seller is the travel agency that sells the trip. bookingUrl opens that trip on the seller's site — give it to the user as the way to book. It is null when the seller can only be compared, not booked, through Kompare.
- start/end are the trip's own first and last day.
- Pass limit (5-10 is plenty) to keep the reply short.
If the filters match nothing, the response instead contains alternatives (facet counts with one filter removed) — use them to suggest what the user could relax.

Tips:
- ALWAYS pass ALL established filters (adults, children, arrivalWeeks/arrivalMonths, niche, market, countries, destinations, etc.) — never drop previously established filters
- Prices depend on group size — always include adults and children
- Start with broad searches, then narrow down with filters
- Use sort=pricePerPerson&order=asc to find cheapest deals
- Use sort=kompareScore&order=desc for Kompare's ranking (see sort above)
- Use sort=providerMix&order=desc for fair provider diversity (round-robin interleave)
- Check search_init first to know valid filter values (topDestinations has exact country/destination slugs)
- Call get_facets before search_listings to verify results exist — use the EXACT SAME filters
